text: The application proposes to amend the Official Plan, the former City of Etobicoke Zoning Code (Site Specific By-law No. 1979-121) and City-Wide Zoning By-law No. 569-2013 to construct a new two- four storey self-storage warehouse building at 2-4 Mendota Road. The northern and western portions of the building would be 2 storeys (8 m in height) abutting the residential uses and the southern and eastern portions of the building would be 4 storeys (15.2 m in height) abutting the Gardiner Expressway. The proposed self-storage warehouse building would have a gross floor area of 11,494 m2 and a total of 29 at-grade parking spaces. Vehicular access would be maintained via Mendota Road. The existing one and two storey self-storage warehouse buildings on site would be demolished. This report provides preliminary information on the above-noted application and seeks Community Council's directions…

Etobicoke York Community Council: 1. Directed staff to schedule a community consultation meeting for the lands at 2-4 Mendota Road together with the Ward Councillor. 2. Directed that Notice for the community consultation meeting be given to landowners and residents within 250 metres of the site, and expanded in consultation with the Ward Councillor, with the additional cost to be borne by the applicant. 3. Directed that Notice for the public meeting under the Planning Act be given according to the regulations of the Planning Act.
